# Original LEZAC.EXE LEVEL-2 kind-1 / behaviour-3 walker evidence.
#
# Tick-locked on DS:0x78C2, one 64 KiB DS pread per tick, sampled from the
# REAL actor table DS:0x1BAE stride 0x26. This is the SECOND level for which
# the recovered actor-contact core has runtime evidence -- the existing
# actor_contact_original_level1.txt covers level 1 only, and "one level" was
# an explicit entry on this item's unevidenced list.
#
# What these rows settle, all of it reproduced by the port's live code and
# checked by actor_contact_level2_evidence:
#
#  * hotspot byte +0x14 = 6 for kind 1 on a level other than 1.
#  * gravity is +0x40 per airborne tick: the one fall in the window runs the
#    ladder 64,128,192,256,320,384,448,512,576,640,704 over 11 consecutive
#    ticks with no rounding drift. The 0x7FF clamp is NOT exercised (the run
#    peaks at 704), so the clamp value stays INFERRED.
#  * the ground walk speed is |vx| = the actor's +0x0E parameter, seeded on
#    the first grounded tick (0 -> 208 at frame 299).
#  * wall contact reflects with trunc(-vx/2) and the NEXT tick restores full
#    speed with the reflected sign: 208 -> -104 -> -208 across frames
#    531/532. That two-tick shape is the recovered rule, observed live.
#  * +0x17/+0x18 (the animation range) move when the walker turns, which is
#    the facing-pair reselection.
#
# Slot 3 corroborates independently with a different parameter: |vx| = 184
# and the same halving on contact (-92).
